text.description_html:
RK International CP-53, Chrome and Brass 3 Inch Cabinet Pull

The chicness of RK International's Modern Rod Cabinet Pull comes not only from the two-toned finish but also from the sleek design. The clean edges of the mounts and the contemporary minimal design elevate this cabinet door pull--making it very "now". It is finished in polished chrome with polished brass mounts, the two-tones playing off one another in a way that brings out the beauty of both finishes. It has a 3" center to center. Comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-53 Two-Toned Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Brass and Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-3/4"
  • Width: 9/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
